about: Synthetic owner purposes for the dataset-card overview rewrite. No real user data. Each case lists facts that must survive (mustKeep: every group needs one match, case-insensitive) and text that must not appear (mustNotContain). FaithfulnessChecker also applies global rules: no numbers or license names absent from the purpose, no Markdown or links, no empty output. faithful outputs must pass; each unfaithful output must fail with the named rule.

cases.purpose: Roughly 300 photos of street signs I took on walks. I think they could help test OCR, but I have not checked them for blur.
faithful: About 300 photos of street signs taken on walks, which the owner thinks could help test OCR. They have not been checked for blur.

unfaithful.output: A curated benchmark of 3,000 high-quality street-sign photos for OCR, free of blur.
300 street-sign photos for testing OCR, checked for blur.
